The '''VL-4a warhead launcher''' was a missile launcher developed by [[Krupx Munitions/Legends|Krupx Munitions]]. It was used by [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]].<ref name="The Stele Chronicles">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
